title: Check result
description: launch/<L>/evidence/<T>.json: the result of one check run. Each check runs as /bin/sh -c <command> with cwd the launch root (or --cwd), the parent environment plus FLIGHTCREW_LAUNCH, a 300 second limit, serially in map order; a command that cannot spawn or times out has verdict error, a null exit and a stderr_tail naming the command and the cause. Tails hold the last forty lines of each stream. evidence/summary.json is rebuilt from every evidence file present and holds { ran_at, commit, counts: {pass, fail, error, skipped}, checks: [{id, verdict, covers}], unverified, quarantined, uncovered }.

exit.description: null when the command could not spawn or was killed.

covers.description: Spec node ids, or the literal 'scope'.
